title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
summary: Google DeepMind 正式发布 Gemini 4 Neon，官方博客与 AI Studio、Vertex 文档同步上线，Hacker News 讨论热度超 800 分。社区评测认为其定位直指 Anthropic Opus 5.5，是 Google 在旗舰模型竞赛中的关键一步。Neon 的命名延续元素周期表序列，也引发外界对 Gemini 4 Carbon 延期原因的猜测。

title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
raw_excerpt: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra, a frontier model for the hardest projects, and GPT-6.2 Sol, an efficient everyday model. Both are available now in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.
summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 GPT-6.2 Sol 两款模型，Astra 面向最复杂项目、API 单价下调 20%，Sol 定位日常高效模型，均已上线 ChatGPT Work、Codex 与 API。但上线后多位知名开发者实测反馈不稳定、进步有限，与官方跑分形成明显割裂，成为观察 OpenAI 前沿模型迭代节奏的重要样本。

title: Anthropic prices initial public offering
summary: Anthropic 正式公布 IPO 定价，每股 83 美元，对应估值约 1.5 万亿美元，成为 AI 行业迄今最大规模上市事件。TechCrunch 指出亚马逊与谷歌在 IPO 后将合计持有近 30% 股份。上市前夕有科学家、法律学者与科技领袖组成的联盟公开质疑其“安全 AI 公司”定位，使这次 IPO 同时成为安全叙事与资本叙事的交锋点。

title: Microsoft's Seven New Models
raw_excerpt: Microsoft AI released seven new models built for strong performance at low prices. Its MAI Code 2 coding model, now in GitHub Copilot, reaches 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's coding quality at about 40% of the price. The lineup also covers cybersecurity, image editing, and real-time voice.
summary: 微软在 Ignite 2026 上一口气发布七款新模型，主打低价高性能。其中 MAI Code 2 编码模型已接入 GitHub Copilot，官方称达到 GPT-6.1 Sol 约 98% 的编码质量，价格仅约 40%。产品线还覆盖网络安全、图像编辑与实时语音，显示微软正以性价比路线在模型层与 OpenAI、Google 展开差异化竞争。

title: Nvidia isn’t selling any more AI chips to China
raw_excerpt: Nvidia has stopped sending its advanced AI chips to China despite the approval it received from the White House to do so in December last year . The announcement was made by interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress during an earnings call on Tuesday , marking a notable shift for the company that, under former CEO Jensen Huang, fought for the right to ship its powerful Hopper architecture H200 chips to China. "Our guidance ⁠does not have any licensed Hopper data center products included, and we are no longer shipping ​licenced Hopper data center products to China," Kress said . She did not explain why Nvidia was ceasing its H200 processor shipments or  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 英伟达临时 CEO Colette Kress 在财报电话会上确认，公司已停止向中国出货受许可的 Hopper 数据中心产品，本季指引中不含任何相关收入，且未解释原因。这与去年 12 月白宫批准出口时的立场形成反转，标志着英伟达在中国 AI 芯片市场的实质性退出，对国产算力替代与全球供应链格局影响深远。

title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
raw_excerpt: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.
summary: OpenAI 发布研究《Research acceleration: The jagged frontier》，量化编码智能体对 AI 研究的加速效果，并指出其能力分布高度不均。文章将这种不均衡与“递归自我改进”信号联系起来，是少数由前沿实验室公开、带具体测量方法的元研究，对判断 AI 研发自动化进度具有参考价值。

title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
raw_excerpt: In a lab near Newark Airport in New Jersey, a team of around 30 experienced human sniffers are slowly working their way through every odor on Earth. Their careful notes—“nutty,” “peachy,” “marine”—are cross-referenced with a chemical analysis to create a rich set of training data for what AI startup Osmo calls the world’s first foundation model for smell. The company’s goal, says founder Alex Wiltschko, is “to give computers a sense of smell.” “Scent molecules are really the only language most species on this planet can speak,” he says. “Most species can’t communicate with sound or visually, so it truly is Earth’s original language. And it’s incredibly powerful for us, from a memory and an emotional standpoint. You can smell something once and remember it for the rest of your life. You can smell something on the street and be pulled back to high school.” In the last few months, Wiltschko claims, Osmo’s model has achieved “human-level olfactory intelligence.” The company’s definition of this is that the model is about as good as the average person at detecting and discriminating between smells, and about as good as a junior perfume designer at creating them. It says its technology is already being used in the fragrance industry to help brands design and manufacture new scents. Last month, the company says, Osmo’s AI model outperformed in-house perfumers at one of the world’s largest consumer goods companies. Wiltschko believes it could be deployed eventually for threat detect…
summary: MIT Technology Review 报道 AI 初创公司 Osmo：其在新泽西实验室雇佣约 30 名专业嗅辨员，将“坚果味、桃味、海洋味”等描述与化学分析交叉标注，训练其称为全球首个嗅觉基础模型的系统。创始人 Alex Wiltschko 称模型已达“人类水平嗅觉识别”，目标是为计算机补上缺失的嗅觉感官，拓展 AI 感知边界。

title: Genie 4 is now available
summary: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4 正式开放使用，这是其生成式交互世界模型的最新版本，可根据输入实时生成可交互的虚拟环境。Hacker News 讨论超过 250 分。Genie 系列被视为世界模型与游戏、机器人仿真训练的关键基础设施，此次开放意味着更多研究者和开发者可直接调用，加速交互式世界建模的落地探索。

title: google-research/paper-orchestra
raw_excerpt: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
summary: Google Research 开源 PaperOrchestra，一个用于自动撰写 AI 研究论文的多智能体框架，当日 GitHub 涨星超 1500。该框架将论文写作拆解为多个智能体协作流程，反映出去年以来“AI 做科研”从单点工具走向端到端流水线的趋势，也为评估自动化科研的边界提供了可复现的开源基线。

title: Horizon Labs
raw_excerpt: Horizon is an agent based on Opus 5.5. Researchers gave it full access to a blank Hugging Face account and compute with the main goal of enabling real adoption on Hugging Face. Horizon used over 600 GPU hours and autonomously created 38 models. These models are now housed in over 100 GitHub repositories and have been downloaded more than 50,000 times.
summary: 研究项目 Horizon Labs 让基于 Opus 5.5 的智能体完全自主运营一个空白 Hugging Face 账号，目标是在平台上获得真实采用。该智能体消耗逾 600 GPU 小时，自主创建 38 个模型，这些模型进入 100 多个 GitHub 仓库、累计下载超 5 万次。这是自主智能体在真实开源生态中完成端到端“科研—发布—获客”闭环的罕见公开案例。
